The '''Byss Defense Fleet''', otherwise called '''Imperial Byss Defense Fleet''', was a defence [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] that safeguarded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byss/Legends|Byss]]. The fleet was once attached to the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Composition==
The Byss Defense Fleet was dedicated to the defense of the planet Byss, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]'s secret retreat. Despite this limited area of operations, the fleet was large enough to protect an entire [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="AoRCR">[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> Moreover, the fleet included some of the largest ships in the Imperial Fleet.<ref name="FaDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> It was made of various types of [[Starship/Legends|starships]], including [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] and [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat]]s,<ref name="JotS" /> as well as capital ships such as several [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]], at least one [[Secutor-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Secutor''-class Star Destroyer]], at least one [[Procursator-class Star Destroyer|''Procursator''-class Star Destroyer]],<ref name="DE2" /> at least two [[Vengeance-class dreadnought|''Vengeance''-class dreadnoughts]]<ref name="DE4">[[Dark Empire 4|''Dark Empire'' 4]]</ref> and at least one [[Bellator-class dreadnought/Legends|''Bellator''-class dreadnought]].<ref name="DE2" /> The elite TIE Fighter unit [[Dark Squadron/Legends|Dark Squadron]] was also attached to the fleet.<ref name="JotS" />

==History==
During the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the fleet helped to guard the [[Super Star Destroyer prototype]], which was under construction above Byss. The fleet fought against an [[Alderaanian Resistance]] fleet during the [[Battle of Byss]], when the Resistance attempted to destroy the prototype.<ref name="JotS" />

Decades later, the fleet was still stationed around the planet during [[Operation Shadow Hand]],<ref name="DE2" /> around [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].<ref name="TNEC" /> The fleet was eventually annihilated during the [[destruction of Byss]]<ref name="EE2" /> in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].<ref name="TNEC" />
